name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)

eligibility.house_ownership: No pucca house anywhere in India

benefits: Interest subsidy of 4% on first ₹8 lakh of home loan (up to ₹1.8 lakh subsidy). Central assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh per unit for EWS beneficiaries.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)

eligibility.additional: Senior citizens aged 70+ eligible irrespective of income from Oct 2024

benefits: Cashless health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care. Extra ₹5 lakh top-up for senior citizens 70+.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi

eligibility.land_requirement: All landholding farmers with cultivable land
eligibility.exclusions: Institutional landholders, income tax payers, constitutional post holders

benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months directly to bank account

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

eligibility.requirement: Indian citizen, no existing bank account

benefits: Zero balance savings account, RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accidental insurance, overdraft facility up to ₹10,000

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)

eligibility.requirement: No existing LPG connection in household

benefits: Free LPG connection with first cylinder and stove. Subsidy on refills via DBT.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)

eligibility.business_type: Non-farm micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, services

benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001-₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5-10 lakh)

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60. Spouse continues to receive pension after subscriber's death.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
benefits: 8.2% interest rate (current), tax-free maturity. Minimum deposit ₹250/year, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year. Maturity at 21 years or marriage after 18.

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana

eligibility.requirement: Own residential house with suitable rooftop, valid electricity connection, no previous solar subsidy

benefits: Subsidy up to ₹78,000 for rooftop solar installation. Up to 300 units free electricity per month. ₹30,000/kW for first 2kW, ₹18,000/kW for additional 1kW.

name: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman Yojana

eligibility.occupation: Traditional artisans in 18 notified trades (carpenter, potter, tailor, blacksmith, etc.)
eligibility.exclusions: Not availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra in last 5 years

benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit grant, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, collateral-free loans (₹1 lakh first, ₹2 lakh second at 5% interest)

name: NPS Vatsalya Yojana

eligibility.requirement: Parents/legal guardians can open account for minor

benefits: Pension scheme for minors with minimum ₹1,000 annual contribution. Tax benefits under Section 80C (₹1.5 lakh) and 80CCD(1B) (₹50,000). Converts to regular NPS at 18.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

eligibility.requirement: Vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020, with Certificate of Vending or ULB recommendation

benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (first tranche), ₹20,000 (second), ₹50,000 (third). 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment, ₹1,200/year cashback on digital transactions.

name: PM SHRI Schools

eligibility.requirement: Schools with pucca building, electricity, library, separate toilets, above state-average enrollment

benefits: Central assistance of ₹1 crore per school for 5 years. Upgraded infrastructure, modern facilities, NEP 2020 aligned education. 14,500+ schools to be developed.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)

eligibility.occupation: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, FFPOs

benefits: Subsidy 40% of project cost (General), 60% (SC/ST/Women). Credit guarantee up to ₹2 crore. Support for fishing vessels, aquaculture, cold storage, processing units.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)

eligibility.requirement: BPL families, delivery in government/accredited private health facility

benefits: Cash assistance ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) for institutional delivery. ₹500 for home delivery (BPL only). ASHA incentive ₹600 (rural) / ₹400 (urban).

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)

eligibility.occupation: Unorganized workers (street vendors, rickshaw pullers, construction workers, etc.)

benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60. 50:50 contribution model with government. Family pension 50% to spouse on death of subscriber.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)

eligibility.requirement: First child (₹5,000 in two installments), second child if girl (₹6,000 one installment). Not in regular government employment.

benefits: Cash incentive ₹5,000 for first child (₹1,000 on early registration, ₹2,000 after ANC, ₹2,000 after birth registration and immunization). ₹6,000 for second girl child.

name: Stand Up India Scheme

eligibility.requirement: Greenfield project in manufacturing, trading or services. 51% shareholding for non-individual enterprises.

benefits: Bank loans ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore. Composite loan (term + working capital). Repayment up to 7 years with 18 months moratorium. Credit guarantee under CGFSI.

name: Startup India Scheme

eligibility.requirement: DPIIT recognized, Private Limited/LLP/Partnership, innovative scalable business model

benefits: 3-year income tax exemption, 80% rebate on patent filing, fast-track IPR, self-certification under labour/environment laws, funding support via Fund of Funds, easier public procurement
